The Company

An established services group based in Brussels, present across several European countries and recognised for the quality of its offering to a demanding professional client base. Around a hundred employees, a tight-knit finance team and an environment where numbers genuinely inform decisions, not just dashboards.

What sets this role apart: a dual accounting and analytical dimension, direct exposure to senior management and varied stakeholders, internally and internationally. The offices are well located in Brussels, easily accessible by public transport.

Your Responsibilities

You are the financial reference point for the Belgian office, with a role that goes well beyond bookkeeping.

• Leading monthly and annual closings: general ledger, provisions, fixed assets and balance sheet reconciliations.
• Preparing and filing local statutory and regulatory obligations.
• Analysing financial performance, monitoring variances and providing recommendations to management.
• Acting as a business partner for operational teams and senior management: budgets, forecasts and ad hoc analyses.
• Trusted point of contact for partners, external stakeholders and auditors.
• Contributing to the continuous improvement of processes and reporting tools.

The Ideal Profile

Education : Bachelor's or Master's degree in accounting or finance.

Experience : Minimum 7 years of experience in general accounting. You take the lead on closings without needing guidance, and you are not afraid to go and get the information you need from the right people: management, partners, stakeholders.

Languages ; Fluent English is essential. French or Dutch is required for local interactions.

Personal qualities

• Confident and assertive, you hold your own in a conversation without overstepping.
• Rigorous on substance, pragmatic on form.
• Curious about business challenges, you like to understand what lies behind the numbers.

As a Junior Talent Acquisition, you will join a growing recruitment team and take responsibility for sourcing, assessing and presenting candidates for a wide variety of specialist roles. This is an ideal opportunity for someone with around one year of recruitment experience who wants to develop their recruitment expertise in a fast-paced, business-oriented environment.

Client Details

Our client is an international technology and professional services company supporting projects for large organisations. With a strong focus on expertise, quality and long-term partnerships, the company is growing its recruitment activities and is looking for a motivated Junior Talent Acquisition to strengthen its team in Brussels.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition, you will manage the recruitment process from understanding the hiring need to presenting suitable candidates. Your main responsibilities will include:

• Understanding recruitment needs with internal stakeholders and translating them into clear candidate profiles.
• Sourcing and attracting candidates through LinkedIn, databases, job boards and other channels.
• Screening applications and conducting first interviews to assess skills, motivation and cultural fit.
• Managing several vacancies simultaneously and building strong candidate pipelines.
• Matching candidates'profiles with specific project and business requirements.
• Presenting shortlisted candidates to internal stakeholders and following up throughout the selection process.
• Coordinating recruitment-related administration and ensuring a smooth candidate journey.
• Maintaining close communication with both candidates and internal stakeholders throughout the process.

You are:

• Proactive, reliable and comfortable taking ownership of your work.
• Well organised and able to manage several priorities in a fast-paced environment.
• Comfortable asking questions and seeking clarification when needed.
• A strong communicator with a professional and collaborative mindset.
• Genuinely interested in recruitment and candidate sourcing.
• Fluent in French and English.
• Experience recruiting IT, digital or technical profiles is a strong plus, but not a requirement.
• Familiarity with LinkedIn Recruiter, an ATS or other sourcing tools is an advantage.

Job Description

If you like these keywords, you’ll love this role:
#M365 #Entra #Defender #Purview #Intune

What’s more fundamental in IT these days than a Digital Workplace that is fully secured and compliant by end users?
Develop, design, and build the future with us as a Microsoft 365 Workplace Security Architect.

As a Workplace Security Architect, you know the solutions that can help in increasing the workplace security maturity. You know what Zero-trust is and how you can use Microsoft technology to protect customers against cyberthreats. You will work with Client’s Business & Technical employees to capture, discuss, create, build, deliver & verify solutions.

 

Qualifications

For this position, we’re looking for all seniority levels.

• [Must-have] You have a broad view of the Modern Workplace building blocks, from classic solutions to Microsoft 365.
• [Must-have] You have a broad view of all the Microsoft 365 Defender Solutions
• [Must-have] You have expertise on how to secure Endpoints, Identities, Apps and Data with Microsoft 365 Defender, Intune, Entra and Purview.
• [Must-have] You can design an entire architecture that protects the corporate data and prevent data loss.
• [Must-have] You are an expert in one or more Microsoft (365) solutions.
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise with Defender for Cloud and/or Microsoft Sentinel.
• [Nice-to-have] You have experience and/or a talent to deliver results-driven workshops with the customer to capture requirements, explain the new way of working that can be realized with out-of-the-box M365, and the benefits that can be realized.
• [Nice-to-have] You have expertise or affinity with the Microsoft Power low-code Platform or Ometa to further automate and increase productivity in
• [Nice-to-have] You’re ready to drive change and bring creative tech ideas to life.
• [Nice-to-have] You’re either proficient in Dutch or French (or you want to learn) and fluent in English.
• [Bonus-points] MS certified (or willing to obtain). Certifications in scope: SC-100, SC-300, SC-400, MS-102, MS-203 etc.
If you do not feel fully confident that you meet the requirements above, please don’t worry. Just apply. Together we’ll discover what you can bring to the table, in which role you would fit best and how you could potentially grow at Devoteam.

Our promises to you

• As a digital native you will have a positive impact at top organizations in Belgium.
• Direct access to the Microsoft organization and programs thanks to our global partnership.
• Prepare to inspire and be inspired by other Devoteamers in tech communities.
• We enable local and international collaboration and exchange with other tech leaders and specialists, knowledge sharing, peer-to-peer coaching.
• A personalized career plan with training offers in soft- & hard skills and certifications aligned to your needs & expertise.
• 
Our servant leadership supports opportunities to grow your personal brand through blogs, keynote sessions, and more.

What you will do
 

Join our multidisciplinary foundry support team, the crucial interface between cutting-edge chip foundries and our valued customers. From the inception of design to the final Tape-Out phase, you are there to answer any technical queries related to technologies, libraries, and verification decks. 
 

In this role you are responsible for: 
 
 

• Interfacing between world-class chip foundries (chip manufacturing plants) and our customers. You will support universities, startups, SME’s and system houses from design start until the moment they are ready to tape out and guide them on the technical side of their designs. 

• Providing our worldwide customers with chip design guidelines, design rules, libraries and design kits and assisting with installing and using them before and during the chip design phase. 

• Answering questions about how to use the technology and libraries to create an ASIC. For this you have a team of experienced colleagues and a support team at the foundry to support you where needed. 

• Using the most advanced Electronic Design Automation software from leading vendors to investigate test cases and provide support.  

• Assisting the sales team in technical discussions with customers.   

Who you are
 
 

• You have at least a master’s in electronics and semiconductor, with 3 to 5 years of relevant experience 

• You have experience in analog and/or digital chip design. The more the better.  

• Knowledge of chip-fabrication techniques is a must.  

• Having experience with ASIC CAD tool support is a plus 

• You have experience with project-based work.  

• You are customer-oriented and enjoy taking initiative.  

• You are proactive in customer support. 

• You possess strong written and oral communication skills. A good knowledge of English is mandatory.

At Ball, integrity and trust are the foundation of who we are. Guided by our core values —"We Care. We Work. We Win.”— we create a culture where every voice matters and every idea drives progress. 

Further your career at Ball, a world leader in manufacturing sustainable aluminium packaging. Achieve extraordinary things when you join our team, and make a difference in your professional development, the community, and around the globe! 

Create a new future. Apply Today.
 

 
 

Position overview:
 

The role supports the EHS Manager to ensure and safeguard environmental, health and safety (EHS) aspects, fire safety and property protection (FSPP) sustainability programmes to ensure the safety and well-being of all workers and protection of the environment. Also he/she will provide advice and guidance to plant management on EHS, FSPP, and any other safety, health, well-being issues. Safety Advisor will support EHS Manager with daily management of EHS and FSPP risks to ensure the plant meets it compliance obligations and Ball requirements and implements best practice. The job position helps coordinate EHS activity.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Point of contact for the external service personnel responsible for psychosocial aspects, occupational hygiene, ergonomics, and occupational medicine. 

• Assist in the identification of hazards. Provide advice on appropriate risks and propose possible (preventive) measures. 

• Provide training within the framework of a stable safety culture. 

• Provide advice and proposals regarding the purchase of work equipment, PPE, and the layout of workplaces. 

• Drafting the Annual Action Plan and the Global Prevention Plan. Maintaining records regarding occupational accidents and reporting them. Implementing the annual action plan. 

• Investigating workstations, conducting a thorough, in-depth examination of the workplaces and workstations. 

• Drafting safety instructions. 

• Providing advice and supervision regarding fire prevention. 

• Identifying, relevant, and inventorying risks. Supporting solutions and their implementation. 

• Objectively document and record on-site findings in a report. Collect additional information useful for the report. 

• Handle the administrative follow-up of the execution of assignments and decisions made. Gather and classify all documents in the file. Prepare reports in accordance with regulations. 

• Prepare risk analyses and job description sheets. 

• Organize medical examinations in collaboration with the external service.  

 
 

What Are We Looking For?
 
 

• Level I or II Prevention Advisor certification. 

• Experience of min 2-3 years as Safety Advisor. 

• Experience in industry. 

• Fluent English and Dutch.

Position overview:
 

We are seeking a detail-oriented and organized individual to join our HR team as a Payroll Officer. This role involves managing various aspects of payroll processing, ensuring accurate and timely payment to employees while maintaining compliance with all relevant labor laws and regulations.
 

 
 

Key responsibilities include:
 
 

• Process payroll for all employees, including hourly, salaried, and commissioned staff. Process payroll adjustments, such as retroactive pay, bonuses, and deductions. 

• Collect, verify, and input employee time and attendance data. 

• Calculate wages, deductions, and taxes according to applicable laws and company policies. 

• Maintain accurate employee records, including personal information, tax withholdings, and benefit deductions. 

• General HR administration (contract, benefits, leave management, labour accidents, medical examinations, control doctor, documentation, training etc.) 

• Support with local communications related to HR. 

• Support and manage data management in ERP HR systems. 

• Prepare and distribute pay stubs and other payroll-related documents.. 

• Ensure compliance with all federal, state, and local payroll regulations. 

• Utilize payroll software to efficiently process payroll data. 

• Monthly reporting, like payroll/attendance reports 

• Follow the payroll automatization project  

 
 

What we are looking for?
 
 

• Bachelor's degree in an HR-related field of study, or proven experience in the field. 

• Minimum two years' experience in payroll processing preferred. 

• Strong understanding of payroll principles and practices. 

• Proficiency in payroll software and Microsoft Office Suite. 

• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy. 

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 

• Fluent in speaking and writing Dutch & English.

For a large-scale industrial project in the 
Port of Antwerp, we are looking for an experienced 
Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I) Inspector.
 

You will join an international project environment within the petrochemical industry, where 
English is the main working language. Your focus will be on ensuring that all electrical and instrumentation works are executed safely, correctly and in accordance with project specifications, applicable standards and approved documentation.
 

Your role
 

As an E&I Inspector, you will be closely involved in the construction, installation and pre-commissioning phases of the project. You will spend a significant amount of time in the field, following up contractors and verifying the quality and compliance of the E&I installations.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 
 

• Inspecting electrical and instrumentation installations during construction and completion 

• Verifying installations against approved drawings, specifications, datasheets and relevant standards 

• Checking cable routing, cable trays, cable pulling and termination 

• Inspecting junction boxes, field instruments, panels, switchgear and other E&I equipment 

• Checking instrument installation, impulse tubing and associated hook-ups 

• Verifying grounding, bonding and earthing installations 

• Performing and witnessing electrical and instrumentation tests 

• Following up loop checks, continuity tests, insulation resistance tests and functional testing 

• Verifying installations in hazardous areas and checking compliance with 
ATEX requirements 

• Reviewing inspection and test records, punch lists and construction documentation 

• Identifying non-conformities and following up corrective actions with contractors 

• Supporting mechanical completion and pre-commissioning activities 

• Coordinating closely with construction, engineering, QA/QC and commissioning teams 
 

• A technical degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Instrumentation, Automation or a related discipline 

• Several years of experience as an 
E&I Inspector, QA/QC Inspector or E&I Supervisor in an industrial environment 

• Experience within 
petrochemical, chemical, oil & gas or other process industries 

• Strong knowledge of electrical and instrumentation installation practices 

• Experience with 
ATEX / hazardous area installations 

• Familiarity with relevant IEC standards and industrial E&I practices 

• Experience with inspection procedures, ITPs, punch listing and quality documentation 

• The ability to read and interpret 
single-line diagrams, wiring diagrams, loop diagrams, hook-ups, P&IDs and technical datasheets 

• A strong focus on safety, quality and technical compliance 

• Good communication skills and the confidence to address contractors when installations do not meet the required standards 

• A professional working proficiency in 
English
